notes: Realistic prompts a user would actually send. Run each with the skill and without it, then compare: does the with-skill run bootstrap the upstream skills, open real galleries, produce a scout file with named references and a library map, and use shadcn primitives instead of raw HTML?

evals.prompt: Build me a landing page for a CLI tool that turns Postgres queries into shareable charts. Next.js, Tailwind. Make it look like a real design studio made it.
evals.expected_output: A Next.js page using shadcn primitives; a .beyond-ui/scout.md naming real gallery URLs and a library map with install commands; an explicit direction contract (type, colour, motion); no 3-equal-cards row, no purple gradient hero, no emoji.
assertions: Bootstrap ran or its absence is recorded in state.json skills.missing with a reason
.beyond-ui/scout.md exists and cites 6+ distinct source URLs with what was taken from each
Library map lists at least one shadcn registry install command and the base shadcn components
No raw <button>/<input> where a shadcn primitive exists
A design contract section names the type faces, the accent colour value, and the motion easing set
No gradient text headline, no three-equal-column feature row, no emoji icons
Screenshots or a rendered check at 390/768/1440 recorded as evidence

evals.prompt: our dashboard looks like every other AI-generated SaaS admin. redesign the billing overview page with actual polish and some taste. it's a vite react app with tailwind v3 and shadcn already set up
evals.expected_output: A restrained redesign inside the existing v3 token system: no new Tailwind v4 snippets, no second motion library, borders reduced, hierarchy fixed, all states designed, contrast verified in both themes.
assertions: Tailwind v3 confirmed before any component/library is added; no v4-only syntax
No new motion library installed when framer-motion/motion already present
Existing tokens extended rather than a parallel token set created
Loading, empty and error states present for the table/chart surface
Contrast measured for new colour pairs in both light and dark
Critique recorded with hard fails found and fixed, plus a gate mean

evals.prompt: add a nice animated pricing toggle to my pricing page, with monthly/yearly and a saving badge
evals.expected_output: A small, scoped change: scout 3 references minimum, one registry component adapted (or shadcn Tabs animated), keyboard accessible, reduced-motion handled, no layout shift.
assertions: Scout performed even though the task is one component (3+ references)
Component built on an accessible primitive (Tabs/radio group) with keyboard support
prefers-reduced-motion handled and verified
No layout shift when the toggle changes; card height stable
Price values are real DOM text, not canvas/SVG-only

evals.prompt: build a 3D product page for a configurable sneaker — react three fiber, next.js. user should be able to rotate it and pick colourways
evals.expected_output: A justified 3D implementation: THREEJS.md consulted, R3F + drei scene lazy-loaded with a static poster as the LCP element, optimised GLB (gltfjsx --transform / Draco + KTX2), colourways driven by state, keyboard-operable controls, reduced-motion freeze, payload and FPS recorded.
assertions: references/THREEJS.md followed: justification for 3D stated, not just assumed
Canvas lazy-loaded (dynamic/React.lazy) with a static poster as the LCP element
Model pipeline recorded: gltfjsx --transform or gltf-transform with Draco/KTX2; asset bytes reported
dpr capped, frameloop demand or off-screen pause, instancing/reuse where applicable
Colourway switching works without a full scene reload (material swap on the existing scene)
prefers-reduced-motion freezes auto-rotation; poster shown when WebGL unavailable
Keyboard-operable rotate/variant controls when the 3D is the product content
Asset licences recorded in scout.md; page remains readable without JS (poster + text)
